sample_unit: participants (5 hand surgeons and 28 non-medical individuals)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated and organization-provided patient information versus recommended levels
links.effect: Both ChatGPT/Gemini-generated and established-organization patient information exceeded recommended readability levels for patient comprehension, per six readability formulas.
links.quote: Both sources, however, produced information that exceeded the recommended readability levels for patient comprehension.

screen.reason: Empirical reader/evaluation study assessing the clarity, comprehensiveness, and readability of French patient-facing information generated by ChatGPT and Gemini compared to established organizations, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
